name: codebuild:StartBuild (buildspec-override)
description: Start a build on an existing CodeBuild project using --buildspec-override to inject malicious commands that execute with the project's privileged service role. Does not require iam:PassRole or codebuild:CreateProject.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Must have permission to start builds on the target CodeBuild project

additional.description: Helpful for discovering existing CodeBuild projects with privileged roles
Useful for viewing project details including service role ARN
Helpful for monitoring build execution status and verifying success

admin: A CodeBuild project must already exist in the account
The existing project must have a service role with administrative permissions
The project must allow buildspec overrides (default behavior unless explicitly disabled)
lateral: A CodeBuild project must already exist in the account
The existing project must have a service role with any level of permissions
The project must allow buildspec overrides (default behavior unless explicitly disabled)

options.name: PROJECT_NAME
options.description: Name of the existing CodeBuild project to exploit

options.name: TARGET_ARN
options.description: IAM user or role name/ARN to attach AdministratorAccess to (auto-resolved from caller identity if not set)

options.name: CLEANUP
options.description: Clean up tracked side effects after execution (the payload's IAM change is the goal; default false)

payloads.name: backdoor/attach-policy
payloads.description: Attach AdministratorAccess (or any managed policy) to an IAM user or role via CodeBuild buildspec
